description: Shape of the complete GSTR-1 upload file: the wrapper the portal expects around the per-section payloads. Key ORDER is significant for byte-level comparison against the reference tool and is reproduced exactly as the official tool emits it.

provenance.source: The tool builds this wrapper by string concatenation in utility/common.js (formDataFormat), so the key order and the empty-value shapes below are literal.

notes: `version` is a literal tied to the tool release, not to the return.
`hash` is the literal four-character string 'hash' — a placeholder the tool never fills in.
`gt` and `cur_gt` (aggregate turnover) appear immediately after `fp` and only when a numeric turnover is supplied; the tool omits both when the value is not a number.
`hsn` changes shape with the return period: a single `data` array before 05-2025, and `hsn_b2b` / `hsn_b2c` arrays from 05-2025 onward (HSN_BIFURCATION_START_DATE).
`hsnSac` is emitted as an always-empty array alongside `hsn`; no template sheet feeds it.
Every section key is present even when empty, so an upload file always carries the full set.

filename.description: The tool writes returns_<MMYYYY>_<form minus its first three characters>_<GSTIN>_offline.json; for GSTR1 that middle segment is 'R1'.

chunking.description: The tool splits an upload into chunks at 4.7 MiB (4.7 * 1024 * 1024), not the 5 MB the portal documentation mentions.
